segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers mostly report balanced, less-greasy skin and no over-drying, though one reviewer with oily/acne-prone skin says it triggered extra sebum and breakouts.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers generally say it cleans without stripping or tightness, but several others with dry or dry-in-winter skin describe it as too drying, with tightness and stinging.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as balancing oily T-zone areas while leaving dry patches soft, with mostly positive results.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers frequently report no irritation or breakouts and gentle cleansing, but a minority describe swelling, irritation, or dislike of the fragrance-free formula.
segments.normal: Normal-skin reviewers give mixed reports, from clean and non-tight skin to one case of dryness and leftover makeup residue.
segments.mature: One mature-skin reviewer says it cleanses well without over-drying her already dry, mature skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers mention reduced hyperpigmentation, brighter skin, and smaller-looking pores over time; no dissent noted specifically on aging.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the gel does not strip or dry the skin, even calling it hydrating; however multiple others, especially with dry or sensitive skin, report tightness, stinging, and dry patches requiring more moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers with rosacea or reactive/red skin report reduced redness and no irritation.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers highlight it as gentle enough for daily use even alongside retinoids without irritation, while a couple describe reactions, stinging, or swelling suggesting barrier upset.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers note fading dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and PIE lightening with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts, faster healing of active blemishes, and reduced blackheads; a few reviewers say it caused new pimples or cystic-type breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Most oily-skin reviewers say the product controls oil and reduces shine, though one reviewer felt it did not reduce oil production and another said it increased sebum and breakouts.

extraits.texte: I have found this cleanser to be too drying for me personally, though I see many others disagree so YMMV. I have pretty dry skin at baseline especially in the winter, and Ive had some dry patches and stinging since switching to this cleanser. I have needed a massive increase in the amount of moisturizer I'm using to keep up. I was hoping to find a gel cleanser I liked just because I prefer the texture but seems cream cleanser will still be the way to go. Also as some others have mentioned the packaging is horrible, the first one I got was broken and Ulta replaced it, the second is intact but now gets jammed and clogged all the time.

Love this cleanser, even got my fiancé obsessed with it too. We've been through multiple bottles and will continue to buy more. The gel texture feels very silky and soothing, and overall my skin looks healthier since I started using it. I have very sensitive oily skin and I have not experienced any irritation or breakouts from this cleanser, nor does my face feel dry or tight if I don't put moisturizer on immediately after. It's a great product. I also love the pump dispenser. I only removed 1 star because it doesn't always completely remove eye makeup, and I haven't noticed much difference in oil production. Those things are not a big deal to me, but were worth noting for the review.

This cleanser leaves my dry skin feeling very clean, and only a little stripped. I'd say this is a great option for someone who has combination-dry skin like me, it balances out my skin really well I will probably buy this again.

extraits.titre: Best Cleanser I have ever used
extraits.texte: I picked this cleanser up on a complete whim after seeing it in the store and I am so glad I did. It is like a double cleanse in one step. Heavy mineral sunscreen melts away. My skin in clog and break out prone and I have to be careful because I will break out if I use an oil cleanser and don't cleanse thoroughly enough with the second step. It is really nice to avoid this but still get all my sunscreen off in one step. I adore the consistency. It has a plush gel texture that turns to soft creamy bubbles and rinses completely clean but without leaving that tight feeling. It nudged out my previous HG cleanser that I thought I would never stop using: Krave Matcha Hemp.

I have to be very careful with my skincare products given my skin is very reactive, acne prone and I also have rosacea, so when I saw the ingredient list, was very excited to try and it is now my absolute favorite cleanser! It lathers beautifully so you only need a few pumps and it leaves your face feeling so clean but not dry after just feeling so very fresh. The scent is mild but smells good like just a clean clinical scent with ingredients that really do smooth our your skin and leave it looking radiant! I also have the niacinamide zinc serum I use for spot treatment after cleansing. Get this cleanser!

I leave it on my skin for normally 2-5 minutes and my pores look smaller, I just wanted a cleanser that wouldn't dry out my skin and I got so much more! People think I wear makeup because my skin looks so smooth and I'm not constantly red anymore (rosacea).
If you're looking for an affordable cleanser that actually works, this is it. I have extremly dry skin and every time I use this, it never dries my face out. Love it!
